decision.title: Book.isbn deprecated upstream; isbn13 added
decision.question: API 2.0.0 marks Book.isbn deprecated and adds Book.isbn13 (string). The selection says all fields, so reconcile reports isbn13 as unmapped on lumen_books_books, lumen_books_book and lumen_books_searchBooks (and the Book $batch lookup). How should Lumen_Books_Book change?

choices.label: Add isbn13 and mark isbn @deprecated(reason: "Use isbn13")
Add isbn13 and leave isbn as it is
Leave isbn13 off (record it as an omit)
